null of the V30 procedure: 200 draws (seed 2029); in each draw, for each of the four crypto breakouts, the whole descriptor vector of its baseline chain trades is permuted among the trades of the same fold year (training years and applied years alike); the V30 procedure (per-sleeve standardisation, within-sleeve demeaning, screening of 6, ridge alpha = 1 x n, pooled split q = 1/3, stakes 0.5 / 1 / 1.5) is refitted every fold; reports the distribution of the pooled 2019-2021 FP Sharpe ratio to the reference and the share of draws at or above V30's own ratio.
